phase: Sovereign Yield Response — Quarterly Source Materialisation
purpose: Create a definitionally aligned quarterly source table for later preregistered selection/validation, without fitting any yield equation or choosing lag structure from outcomes.

target.concept: Romania 10-year long-term convergence yield in RON, monthly average
target.quarterly_rule: Arithmetic mean of the three published monthly observations in each calendar quarter.
target.completeness_rule: A quarter is usable only when all three calendar months are present and finite; no interpolation or partial-quarter mean.

common_long_rate_control.quarterly_rule: Arithmetic mean of the three published monthly observations in each calendar quarter.
common_long_rate_control.completeness_rule: Require the same three calendar months as the Romania target.
common_long_rate_control.interpretation: Common/euro long-rate control only; subtraction from the RON yield is not labelled a pure credit spread.

financial_stress_control.aggregation_rule: First compute an arithmetic mean over all finite published daily observations inside each calendar month; then compute an equal-weight arithmetic mean of the three monthly means for the quarter.
financial_stress_control.completeness_rule: All three calendar months must contain at least one published finite observation. Missing days are not interpolated and months are equal-weighted so differing business-day counts do not mechanically reweight the quarter.
financial_stress_control.interpretation: External financial-stress control; not a sovereign-risk instrument and not causal identification.

debt_to_gdp.timing: End-of-quarter Maastricht gross debt as percent of GDP.
debt_to_gdp.aggregation: None; use the directly published quarterly observation.

net_lending_borrowing_to_gdp.aggregation: None; use the directly published quarterly observation.
net_lending_borrowing_to_gdp.sign_rule: Positive values are surplus/net lending; negative values are deficit/net borrowing. Do not silently flip the sign in the source table.
net_lending_borrowing_to_gdp.source_resolution_rule: Materialisation must retain the exact provider dimension tuple and raw hash. If the requested direct percent-of-GDP series cannot be resolved unambiguously, stop rather than reconstructing a different fiscal concept.
net_lending_borrowing_to_gdp.revision_note: Eurostat metadata state that Romanian quarterly government non-financial accounts are revised when annual data become available; every live materialisation must therefore retain dataset vintage/update metadata and the raw response hash.

optional_domestic_rate_baseline.source: Existing retained RMD policy-rate reference mode
optional_domestic_rate_baseline.rule: The later structural-selection contract must decide ex ante whether the quarterly policy-rate level/change enters the baseline. Do not decide from yield-fit improvement.

common_history_rule.end: latest quarter complete across every mandatory source

next_gate: After exact source materialisation and provenance retention, write a separate structural-selection contract before any coefficient estimation. The later contract must freeze baseline forms, lag structure, estimation/selection window and untouched evaluation window.

source_materialiser.canonical_repository_promotion: A successful live run creates evidence only. The generated quarterly CSV and provenance must be reviewed and committed explicitly in a later repository step before any structural-selection contract may be opened.
